## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Equal-value adoption should have test coverage because the new mode records a change and rewrites the file even when the setting already matches. The current tests leave that boundary unverified.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:13 — tests — Adopting `{"theme": "dark"}` when `theme` is already `"dark"` has no test verifying the returned changes or resulting file bytes. This branch unconditionally records the key and triggers serialization; the adoption test only exercises a different value, and the unchanged-value test exercises replacement. Add an equal-value adoption test that establishes the expected change list and file contents. — Regressions in adoption’s equal-value behavior can pass the existing suite.

(none)

## Strengths
- The adoption test checks both the returned key and the persisted setting.
- Existing replacement tests cover changed values and byte preservation for unchanged values.
